answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Work waits on the walnut until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
